development_selection: Per task and arm choose minimum development validation FP64 cross entropy across the two learning rates; tie by earlier checkpoint then lower learning rate. No formal validation or heldout data enters LR selection.
checkpoint_selection: Development/fixed update validation at midpoint and final update. Equal-CPU validation at first update crossing 30 seconds and at termination; training clock excludes validation. Select minimum FP64 validation cross entropy, tie earlier update. Save selection before any test/ood access.
equal_cpu_models: Per task choose best nonfrozen physical arm using development validation CE only, plus two_gates, transformer and lif_snn. All use their own development-selected learning rate; choices lock before any formal test opens.
information_contract: All physical arms see the complete active/refractory distribution and mu,sigma,rho,K,r,tau,b. No arm has labels, future observations, or privileged state. Feature transforms are deterministic functions of exactly this same information and the current observed elapsed duration.
feature_matching: Three active deterministic basis coordinates per physical channel in every arm. Single-value-channel controls use a second nonlinear basis of the same value, not dead parameter padding. Information content can be recovered by the common physical gate; this isolates a feature representation, not privileged information.
boundary_contract: value uses the inherited Brownian/Erlang analytic boundary, still a surrogate for content tasks. fixed b=1.3; learned b=.7+2.6sigmoid(a), initial b=1.3, per-channel constant across observations. The latter is an ordinary trained threshold, not a free-boundary oracle.
freeze_contract: Freeze requires_grad for exactly the named inherited parameter group. Boundary group freezes raw_K, not the dynamics-dependent boundary function; the fixed_jg arm supplies the truly static boundary. Content includes frontend/readout and content gates; holding it fixed intentionally reduces trainable count while retaining resident/computational size. Cross-coupled derivatives through remaining groups persist.
first_event_contract: Starting from each outgoing full active/refractory distribution, hold current coefficients/boundary fixed for horizon .1*observed dt. Kill at the next firing, include completion of existing refractory phases, and integrate event flux for F and H. These are next-event forecasts, not repeat counts and not terminal-position events. Killed mass is never normalized.
parameter_matching: Physical nonfrozen arms share identical active layer sizes except 8 learned-threshold parameters (<0.05%). External backbones choose nearest active hidden width to the same target without padding. Transformer then refines its active FFN width to138 at hidden36/heads4, yielding17954backboneparameters versusHCSN17936; no dormant padding. FFN tensors have independent declared seed+370003; all frontends/readouts retain identical seed tensors. Report resident and trainable counts separately; reject nonfrozen backbone max-min gap above3%ofmaximum.

quality_gate.primary: For each paired seed, average ID accuracy differences across the two tasks. Test predeclared one-sided positive-benefit contrasts with Holm correction separately in freeze(5), boundary(2), channel(5), and boundary-by-channel interaction(2) families. Require at least .005 mean accuracy gain and paired 95% lower bound >0. Task-specific ID/OOD effects and two-sided estimates are secondary, not extra independent seed units.
quality_gate.net_benefit: Equal-CPU selected HCSN must exceed each external control by at least 0.02 accuracy on ID and OOD with paired 95% lower bound >0 and Holm-adjusted one-sided exact paired sign-flip p<0.05 across all12task/split/control comparisons, no missing/invalid jobs. Mean Brier may not worsen by more than.01 and ECE by more than.02. Report complete-worker CPU and inference latency separately; passing equal-training-CPU criteria alone is not a whole-system gain.
quality_gate.variance_unit: model seed conditional on this fixed dataset split; 8 seeds do not quantify new dataset/population variability
quality_gate.multiplicity: Holm within predeclared mechanism families and across all12external contrasts; no outcome-based regrouping
quality_gate.finite_permutation_resolution: With8pairedseeds the minimum one-sided exact p is1/256; a12contrast Holm family can pass at.05. Two-sided p is also reported but not used for this directional positive-benefit gate.

boundary_channel_factorial: Full3x2: value/fixed/ordinary learned boundary crossed with JG/ordinary physical moment features. Registered interaction contrasts average paired task effects per seed: (valueJG-valueOrdinary)-(fixedJG-fixedOrdinary), and the corresponding learned-threshold contrast. No interaction benefit is presumed.
preseal_amendments: Specified directional permutation hypotheses and separate predeclared mechanism families before outcomes to avoid an impossible eight-seed two-sided multiplicity gate; previous studies and criteria remain unchanged
cost_contract: Every worker records training clock, evaluation/init/save overhead through total process CPU/wall, selected inference latency, RSS, updates, and all attempted jobs. Coordinator uses wait4 child CPU and own CPU. Do not add contained clocks. Hyperparameter search and failed attempts count. No Joules, GPU throughput, or neuromorphic energy claim.
checkpoint_policy: Store every selected formal checkpoint, every raw supervised validation/test/ood logit/label array, complete training trajectory, initial/final/group hashes, gradient/update diagnostics and all failures. Development stores selected checkpoint and validation arrays only. No seed filtering or silent reruns; retries have new attempt directories.
limitations: Synthetic copy/MQAR, not natural language or foundation modeling
No theorem makes affine J/G optimal for content loss
Two learning rates and 48 development updates are a real equal tuning budget but not an exhaustive strong-baseline search
Pinned Mamba-1 is a faithful serial CPU reference, not fused CUDA performance
Missing real audiovisual heldout, hardware power or general large-scale evidence remains an open blocker
